companyFieldUpdates.description: LiveOak Fiber is a regional broadband provider that builds and operates fiber-to-the-premises networks in Florida and Georgia. Founded in 2022, the company serves residential and business customers in historically underinvested communities through an asset-heavy, recurring-subscription model. InfraRed Capital Partners launched the platform with a US$150 million commitment and remains its majority owner through InfraRed-managed value-add strategies; the exact fund and percentage are not publicly disclosed. MEAG became a minority co-owner in 2024 through InfraRed LiveOak CIV LP, while the exact portfolio-company stake and underlying client split remain undisclosed. Management also retains equity, and debt providers are not treated as owners. No later company-level owner exit or signed ownership change was identified through September 1, 2026.
